name: TSU IBANO
detail: Hon'no gijutsu. Not a blast -- a stabilizing field. Tsu's normals are short and unremarkable; his special enforces baseline reality hard enough to floor anything standing in it. Lean, unhurried, and the only fighter in the slice who can neutralise what the opponent throws.
appearance: Tsu Ibano, a lean young martial artist in the blue Yokai Honno Academy school uniform: a cerulean blue blazer over a white collared shirt and a red necktie, tan trousers, dark brown shoes, short dark brown hair, both hands empty and raised in a fighting stance
